what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Cuba in all host countries combined: people who have asked for protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 288050 Cuban asylum seekers, and the United States hosts the largest share, 42.5%.
Brazil, Mexico and Uruguay are the next largest hosts.

why.text: The sources here don't say why people left Cuba: there are no dated events or armed conflicts for Cuba in them.
UNHCR's figures describe the scale of the movement, not its causes.

when.text: The number of Cuban asylum seekers peaked at 344138 in 2024 and was 288050 at the end of 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025, after a big change between 2021 and 2022.

how.text: These are year-end totals of people whose claims had not yet been decided; refugees from Cuba are counted in a separate series.
The sources don't say which routes people took.
